name: Home
detailed_description:
A boy who ran away from home.

 He finds shelter beneath a bridge and begins to spend each day busking.

 In this new daily life, he encounters unexpected people and small yet meaningful events.
 Why did he leave home?
 And how will this short journey come to an end?

 Enjoy a story that feels like a short musical film, capturing a boy’s quiet journey.

Solo Development — Music, Art, and Writing

 All of the artwork, music, and writing in this game were created solely by the developer.

 Because this story is entirely my own, I wanted it to be shared only through me.

 This is a story born from what some might call a stubborn obsession—

 yet it’s told in a way that’s anything but stubborn.

A Visual Novel with a Quiet Yet Honest Story

 The script is based on the developer’s real life.

 It doesn’t try to force emotion—

 It simply unfolds in a calm, honest way.

 There is no message I’m trying to convey.

 I just want to share my story.

Original Acoustic OST, Written and Performed by the Developer

 This game includes 11 original tracks—

 written, composed, performed, and recorded entirely by the developer.

 From personal songs written by the protagonist to in-universe hit songs rearranged in acoustic style,

enjoy the busking performances that bring the story’s music to life.

Pixel Art That Reflects the Game’s Gentle Tone

 The game’s visual style features simple and quiet pixel art that reflects its mood.

 A bench under the bridge, a cozy spot warmed by a campfire, quiet alleys, and bridges bustling with life.

 Follow the story through the stillness of this calm cityscape.

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA MX250 / GTX 750 or AMD Radeon Vega 7
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek(R) Audio
